Pickup Truck Kills Three, Including MLA's Brother, During Morning Walk

A pickup truck traveling at high speed struck and killed three people during their morning walk in Mungeli. Among the deceased was the brother of MLA Punnulal Mohle. The incident occurred when the pickup truck hit the individuals.
